package levelpractice_test

import (
	"context"
	flow "example.com/level-practice"
	sender "example.com/level-practice/syncsender"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/gameplay/level"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestGeneratedLevelComponent(t *testing.T) {
	flow.RegisterEntity()
	flow.RegisterRoomNestHandlers()
	id, err := entity.BuildEntityID(101, flow.RoomKind)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	room, err := flow.NewRoom(&entity.EntityCreateParam{Id: id})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	manager := entity.NewEntityManager()
	if err = manager.TryAdd(room); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	engine := nest.NewEngine(nest.NestOptionWithGetter(entity.NewManagerAccess(manager)), nest.NestOptionWithWorkerPools(nest.WorkerPoolConfig{Workers: 1, QueueCap: 8}, nest.WorkerPoolConfig{Workers: 1, QueueCap: 8}, nest.WorkerPoolConfig{Workers: 1, QueueCap: 8}))
	if err = engine.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer engine.Shutdown(context.Background())
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	client := sender.NewRoomSender(engine)
	if err = client.Sync_Open(ctx, id, "room", 1); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = client.Sync_Advance(ctx, id, 10, true); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected rollback")
	}
	result, err := client.Sync_Read(ctx, id)
	if err != nil || result.View.Phase != level.Running || len(result.Actions) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("failed handler leaked: %+v %v", result, err)
	}
	if err = client.Sync_Advance(ctx, id, 10, false); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	result, err = client.Sync_Read(ctx, id)
	if err != nil || result.View.Phase != level.Finishing || len(result.Actions) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("timeout: %+v %v", result, err)
	}
	if err = client.Sync_Close(ctx, id, 10); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("closed before receipt")
	}
	// 此替身模拟提交后动作执行。真实永久奖励还须用 Effect.ID 持久去重。
	action := result.Actions[0]
	receipt := level.Receipt{Instance: action.Instance, Epoch: action.Epoch, ID: action.ID, Success: true}
	if err = client.Sync_Complete(ctx, id, receipt, 10); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = client.Sync_Complete(ctx, id, receipt, 10); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = client.Sync_Close(ctx, id, 10); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	result, err = client.Sync_Read(ctx, id)
	if err != nil || result.View.Phase != level.Closed || len(result.Actions) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("close: %+v %v", result, err)
	}
}
